xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4904: Pull here on a Codex conversation replaces its title with injected <recommended_plugins> text

plan.title: Pull here on a Codex conversation replaces its title with injected <recommended_plugins> text
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: After Pull here brings a Codex conversation from a linked machine, the adopted conversation is titled with injected Codex context ('<recommended_plugins> Here is a list of plugins…') instead of the owner's title. Two causes: buildTransfer in src/dashboard/server/services/conversation-release-service.ts settles the transfer store without recordTitle, so the minted record takes facts.title; and facts.title (firstHumanText in src/lib/vault/settle.ts) accepts the Codex <recommended_plugins> user message because CODEX_INJECTED_PREFIXES in src/lib/vault/turns.ts does not list it. vault-continue.ts copies record.title to the adopted row with titleSource 'manual', so the bad title is permanent.
narratives.Proposal: Two layers, both required. (A) buildTransfer passes the owner's conversation title as recordTitle via the conditional spread used at vault-service.ts:274, which fixes the online pull. (B) Add '<recommended_plugins>', '# AGENTS.md instructions', '<turn_aborted>' and '<subagent_notification>' to CODEX_INJECTED_PREFIXES, which fixes the offline pull (it adopts a saved-copy record minted with facts.title), vault browse-copy titles and seed digests. Document the title rule and the prefix list in docs/ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md, configuration/linked-machines.mdx and docs/SESSION-VAULT.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Renaming conversation 3550 or any existing conversation row
- Renaming or backfilling existing vault records whose title came from an injected line
- Changing conversation-pull.ts, vault-continue.ts, adopt.ts or settle.ts
- Changing how the regular vault poller titles non-agent conversations (it keeps using facts.title)
- Treating <task> as an injected prefix
- Any frontend change
- Fixing pulls from an owner that runs a pre-fix Overdeck version (the owner computes the record title; the fix applies once the owner runs this release)

autoDecisions.summary: The owner's conversation title is the authority for a Pull here transfer record title.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's expected behavior is that the adopted conversation keeps the owner's title; the owner row is what the linked-conversation list already shows.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix both layers (owner sends recordTitle, and the Codex injected-prefix list) rather than only one.
autoDecisions.rationale: recordTitle alone leaves the offline pull (saved-copy record minted with facts.title) broken; the prefix list alone keeps a derived title instead of the owner's real one.

autoDecisions.summary: Add the bare prefix '# AGENTS.md instructions' and leave '<task>' as a human turn.
autoDecisions.rationale: A scan of 2,474 local Codex rollouts found AGENTS.md lines both with ' for <path>' and ending at a newline; <task> lines are Overdeck worker briefs that are the real first instruction.

autoDecisions.summary: Accept lower Settlement.turn counts for future Codex settlements.
autoDecisions.rationale: Settlement.turn is display-only (read only by src/cli/commands/vault/show.ts); continuity uses line hashes, so nothing compares turn counts across versions.

autoDecisions.summary: No repair of the already-mistitled conversation 3550 or existing vault records.
autoDecisions.rationale: Record titles are immutable after mint by design (settle.test.ts 'recordTitle never renames an existing record'); the operator can rename one row by hand.
